TOOLING BURST T4n-r1 — the ember residue keeps the painted core's ragged edge (SCOPE CORRECTED: export/effect_kit.py IS in scope — the conductor's T4n allowlist omitted it by mistake; your CPU proposal erode_noise = 0.08 (roughness 0.23, entry 20.0 %, largest component 0.9999) is ACCEPTED as the value) (Run C-5; Matt 2026-09-16 R-C5-34: "Agreed on the circle change"). task_id "T4n-r1". Small, £0 images, no other behaviour change.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4h (all clauses; lap-3 corrected).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/effect_kit.py (kit validation + shader generation — ADD the `erode_noise` field at kit/pieces/material level, default 0), export/godot_import.py (piece_burst_v2: the residue phase — which pixels survive at residue entry and how the innermost region is selected), export/vfx_material.gdshader (erode compares distance_value < erode; outside-in variant), oracle/peak_pieces.py (piece masks, whole-body distance), runs/C-5/t3/T4l/scene_cast_v25/contact.png (the conductor's in-scene look: frames +0.67 s to +1.08 s show the residue as a round disc), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only.

THE DEFECT: the residue is the innermost region of the whole-body distance field, which is a disc by construction; a painted fire's ember heart is ragged. BUILD (minimal, legacy six kits + v1 byte-identical): (1) the outside-in erosion threshold gets a per-pixel NOISE term for v2 — `erode_noise` (0–1, kit field, default 0 = legacy) — using a small tileable value-noise texture emitted by the exporter (or the piece's own band index as a cheap proxy: brighter bands resist erosion longer) so the eroding boundary and the residue boundary follow the painted planes rather than a circle; (2) the residue selection at entry uses the same noised threshold, so the ember heart is the ragged innermost 15–25 % (measured at entry, hold-peak denominator); (3) during the residue the ember dissolve (3, 2, then 1+0) runs as built; (4) set `erode_noise` on fire_burst_e0p_v2 to a value your CPU instrument shows gives a boundary roughness ≥ 0.12 (perimeter² / (4π·area) − 1, i.e. isoperimetric excess) at residue entry while keeping the largest component ≥ 0.9 there.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): CPU residue-entry mask on the T4e-r1 pieces — isoperimetric excess ≥ 0.12 with erode_noise as set, ≈ 0 with erode_noise 0 (the legacy disc); largest component ≥ 0.9 at entry; legacy hash table unchanged; headless import exit 0.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4n-r1/acceptance.json; rendered = conductor's): the numbers above; in-sandbox suite reds named (five standing + env + the two known: one stale headless dissolve assertion, one headless timeout — name them, do not fix unless trivially yours).

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (read only), export/replay.py (export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py and export/vfx_material.gdshader ARE editable), any test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4n-r1/ and runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4n-r1/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4n-r1"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
